interface.evidence: Original problem interface lists only scancode and four direction outputs.

semantics.output_rule: Exactly the matching direction is asserted; all other directions are zero.
semantics.timing: Combinational response to present scancode, no cycle latency or retained output.
semantics.reset_initialization: No clock/reset ports or state are specified; outputs follow input after combinational settling.
semantics.evidence: Original problem says build a circuit recognizing four scancodes using case or if-elseif and maps anything else to none.

numeric.comparison: Exact full-width 16-bit scancode match; no signed arithmetic.
numeric.output_width: Four independent one-bit flags; no truncation, overflow, or rounding.

verification.oracle: Independent per-direction equality checks against the four constants from the original problem.
verification.coverage: Directed arrow-to-arrow and arrow-to-invalid transitions, zero and maximum values, all 65536 binary inputs.
verification.sampling: Drive input and wait one simulation time unit for combinational settling before comparison.
verification.failure_success: $fatal on any mismatch; bounded timeout; PASS line only after all checks.

specification_ambiguities.evidence: Original problem does not specify X/Z scancodes.
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Use exact case matching with zero default; binary input coverage is the required functional oracle and X/Z checks are supplemental implementation checks.
